mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t."comment_id") AS rn FROM ( SELECT "comment_id", "user_id", "uname", "rating", "context", "comments"."create_time", "floor_id", "book_title", "comments"."book_id" FROM BOOKMAN."comments" left join BOOKMAN."user" on "comments"."user_id" = "user"."uid" left join BOOKMAN."book" on "comments"."book_id" = "book"."book_id" ) t ) rt WHERE rt.rn >= #{start} AND rt.rn <= #{end}
